meta.name: pathfinder
meta.description: Map a codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, identify duplicated concerns across features, and propose a unified architecture. Use when asked to "find the ideal path," unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor. Emits a proposed unified flowchart plus per-system /make-plan prompts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将代码库映射为功能流程图，识别重复并统一架构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在重构或统一多个重复系统
copy.tagline_en: Map codebase into feature flowcharts, identify duplicates, and unify architecture
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are refactoring or unifying duplicated systems

howto.what: Claude 会按功能把代码库扫成 Mermaid 流程图,找出跨功能重复的关注点,提出统一架构方案,并生成可复制到 /make-plan 的提示词;它不写实现代码,结果放在 PATHFINDER-<日期>/ 目录。
howto.when: 当你要「找理想路径」、统一重复的系统,或重构前审查架构时触发;它从仓库源码而非构建产物入手,先把功能边界交给你确认再展开。

say.text: 帮我找出这个仓库里重复的系统并给出统一方案
say.note: 产出重复报告与统一架构提案

say.text: 为每个功能画一张带 file:line 的 Mermaid 流程图
为每个统一系统生成 /make-plan 提示词

howto.what_en: Claude maps your repo into feature-grouped Mermaid flowcharts, finds duplicated cross-feature concerns, proposes a unified architecture, and emits /make-plan prompts. It writes no code; outputs go in PATHFINDER-<date>/.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to "find the ideal path," unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor; it starts from source, not build artifacts.

say_en.text: Find the duplicated systems in this repo and propose a unified design
say_en.note: Produces a duplication report and unified proposal

say_en.text: Draw a Mermaid flowchart per feature with file:line labels
Generate the /make-plan prompts for each unified system
